title: Bass First
description: A bass-led dance-pop workout built around a punchy LinnDrum kit and a slithering sawtooth bassline that breathes with an LFO filter. Two peaks bracket a stripped-down valley where the groove loosens and space opens up, before everything snaps back funkier than before.
code:
setcpm(112/4)
arrange(
  [12, stack(
    note("<g1 g1 c2 d2>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(6).range(180, 1200)).resonance(10).decay(0.14).sustain(0).gain(0.9),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95),
    s("~ ~ ~ rim").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).room(0.25)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<g1 g1 c2 d2>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(200, 1600)).resonance(12).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.9),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.95),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.65).pan(sine.range(0.3, 0.7)).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.75).room(0.3),
    n("0 ~ 2 ~ 4 ~ 2 0").scale("G3:minor").s("triangle").lpf(1200).gain(0.5).room(0.4)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<g1 g1 c2 d2>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(300, 2000)).resonance(14).decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.95),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9),
    s("[~ hh]*4").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.7).pan(sine.range(0.25, 0.75)).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("[oh ~]*2 ~ oh").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.8).room(0.3),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 ~").scale("G3:minor").s("sawtooth").lpf(2200).decay(0.1).sustain(0.3).gain(0.6).pan(0.6),
    n("0 ~ ~ 4").scale("G4:minor").s("triangle").lpf(1800).gain(0.45).room(0.45).pan(0.4)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<g1 g1 c2 d2>*4").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(150, 800)).resonance(8).decay(0.2).sustain(0.1).gain(0.85),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.8),
    s("~ ~ rim ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.55).room(0.4),
    n("0 ~ 7 ~").scale("G3:minor").s("triangle").lpf(900).gain(0.5).room(0.6).pan(0.35)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<g1 g1 c2 d2 g1 g1 f1 d2>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(3).range(300, 2200)).resonance(14).decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(1.0),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(1.0).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.9),
    s("hh*8").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.65).pan(sine.range(0.2, 0.8)).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("[oh ~]*2 ~ oh").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.6).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85).room(0.3),
    s("~ ~ ~ sh").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 ~").scale("G3:minor").s("sawtooth").lpf(saw.slow(16).range(800, 2800)).decay(0.1).sustain(0.3).gain(0.65).pan(0.6),
    n("0 ~ 4 ~ 7 ~ 4 2").scale("G4:minor").s("triangle").lpf(2000).gain(0.5).room(0.35).pan(0.4)
  )],
  [12, stack(
    note("<g1 g1 c2 d2>*8").s("sawtooth").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(150, 600)).resonance(8).decay(0.18).sustain(0).gain(0.8),
    s("bd ~ bd ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.85),
    s("~ ~ rim ~").bank("LinnDrum").gain(0.5).room(0.3)
  )]
)
